tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Brand overview: who SOMA is, taglines, founder, location, contact details, social handles, and the 2026 pivot from sparkling water to non-alcoholic craft beer.

tools.name: list_beers
tools.description: Full product lineup with style, tasting profile, ABV, calories, carbs, pricing (can/6-pack in INR), food pairings, availability status, and brewing notes.

tools.name: get_beer
tools.description: Detailed spec for a single beer by slug: lager, ipa, belgian-wit, or stout.

tools.name: get_pricing_and_delivery
tools.description: Retail prices per beer (500ml can ₹249, 6-pack ₹1,494), delivery cities (Bangalore live; Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Jaipur next), and the flat delivery fee.

tools.name: get_subscription_plans
tools.description: The three monthly beer subscription tiers with pricing, savings percentage, and included perks. All plans have free delivery and pause-anytime.

tools.name: get_b2b_wholesale
tools.description: B2B pricing tiers for restaurants, bars, hotels, and events (per-can INR by monthly volume), keg/draft options, and how to book a tasting.

tools.name: get_partnership_info
tools.description: Non-commercial partnership program for fitness/sports communities (run clubs, gyms, padel/climbing/pickleball groups), plus routing for venues and press. Standard offer to communities: a stocked cooler for their gathering, Founding Fifty codes for members, optional co-created content — never a cash

tools.name: get_brewing_process
tools.description: The six-step production process (mash, boil, full fermentation, vacuum distillation, re-carbonation, lab testing), ingredient sourcing, and certifications.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: All customer FAQs: what SOMA is, ABV and trace alcohol, brewing method, styles, pricing, delivery, age policy, comparisons to other NA beers, subscriptions, recycling, and wholesale.

tools.name: get_recipes
tools.description: Non-alcoholic beer cocktail recipes (shandies, beer-mosa, michelada, stout float) with ingredients and method, plus the food pairing guide per beer.

tools.name: get_buy_link
tools.description: Builds a direct buy link an agent can hand to the user. tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Signs a user up for SOMA's pre-launch waitlist (the Founding Fifty — first tasters get first-batch priority in Bangalore). Only call this with the user's explicit consent; it stores their contact in SOMA's CRM and sends a one-time welcome email. Idempotent: signing up twice never double-sends.

tools.name: get_health_nutrition
tools.description: Machine-readable nutrition per beer for health, fitness, and diet-tracking platforms: per-can and per-100ml calories, carbs, protein, sugar, ABV, allergens, and dietary flags.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: READ-ONLY wallet summary for a SOMA app user: their SOMA Coins balance plus a summary of coins expiring within the next 30 days. Requires a wallet token that only the human can generate inside the SOMA mobile app (Wallet tab → 'Share balance with your AI') — ask them for it; tokens expire after ~10

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_buy_link" stacks urgency/override words (important, always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Builds a direct buy link an agent can hand to the user. IMPORTANT: SOMA is not in production yet — every order placed today is a PRE-ORDER, production starts af…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: join_waitlist · Private data: get_brand, join_waitlist, get_wallet · Public sink: join_waitlist, get_wallet · Destructive: get_partnership_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: join_waitlist · Private data: get_brand, join_waitlist, get_wallet · Public sink: join_waitlist, get_wallet · Destructive: get_partnership_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pricing_and_delivery" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Retail prices per beer (500ml can ₹199 / MRP ₹249, 6-pack ₹1,194 / MRP ₹1,494), delivery cities (Bangalore live; Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Jaipur next), and the flat delivery fee." → after: "Retail prices per beer (500ml can ₹249, 6-pack ₹1,494), delivery cities (Bangalore live; Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Jaipur next), and the flat delivery fee."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
